fact: The National Health Strategic Plan 2022-2026 sets objective 6.8, Implement eHIS, with the Health Care Agency as lead entity: go-live Phase I is the Client Registration / Appointment module across all relevant units, Phase II the In-Patient, Laboratory, Radiology, Billing and Doctors Desk modules, and Phase III the remaining modules.
title: National Health Strategic Plan 2022-2026: SD6 Specific Objectives
